mcqa.scope: Audit history only: these response-run values score single-token space-prefixed answer labels and are not protocol-matched to the canonical bare continuation-label scorer.

mme.scoring: Maximum next-token logit over yes/no surface-form token IDs, independent of A/B/C/D answer-token choice.
mme.directional_summary: Text cost exceeds visual cost in nine model cells and ties in one.

checkpoint_provenance.limitation: The three supplemental Gemma-3 runs record the exact model IDs but not immutable checkpoint revisions; the historical producer loaded the distributor default revision available at run time.

paired_inference_evidence.available: Per-cell historical p-values and aggregate counts of 2/80 nominal positive and 24/80 nominal negative cells.
paired_inference_evidence.unavailable_after_exhaustive_safe_artifa: Per-cell McNemar discordance b/c counts or a redistributable paired-prediction table for this response-run breadth grid.
paired_inference_evidence.restriction: The release recomputes the counts from stored historical p-values but does not claim to independently reconstruct those p-values. No benchmark-linked predictions are redistributed.
